items.tr: Bundan tamamen soğudum, artık umurumda değil
items.example: I'm so over it. Please stop talking about my ex.
items.exampleTr: Artık umurumda değil. Lütfen eski sevgilimden bahsetmeyi bırak.
items.simple: You used to care a lot, but now you do not care at all.
dialogue: A: Are you still sad about Mark?
B: Honestly, I'm so over it.
A: Good. He was never nice to you.
items.note: Friends ve HIMYM'de ayrılık sonrası sık duyulur.

items.example: He finally made a move at the party.
items.exampleTr: Sonunda partide ilk adımı attı.
items.simple: To show a person you like them by doing something brave.
dialogue: A: She keeps smiling at you.
B: Should I make a move?
A: Yes! Before somebody else does.
items.note: HIMYM'de Barney tarzı flört konuşmalarında geçer.

items.example: He got stuck in the friend zone again.
items.exampleTr: Yine arkadaş bölgesinde sıkıştı.
items.simple: When a person likes you only as a friend, not as a love.
dialogue: A: She called me her best buddy.
B: Oh no, the friend zone.
A: Is there any way out?
items.note: HIMYM ve Big Bang Theory'de espri konusudur.

items.example: My sister sent me on a blind date last night.
items.exampleTr: Kız kardeşim dün gece beni kör randevuya gönderdi.
items.simple: A date with someone you have never met before.
dialogue: A: I have a blind date tonight.
B: How will you know him?
A: He'll be holding a red book.
items.note: Friends'te sık işlenen bir durum.

items.example: You fixed it already? Way to go!
items.exampleTr: Zaten tamir ettin mi? Aferin sana!
items.simple: You say it when someone does something good. Sometimes it is a joke.
dialogue: A: I got the job!
B: Way to go!
A: Dinner is on me tonight.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da hem samimi hem alaycı.

items.en: You've got to be kidding me
items.example: You've got to be kidding me. The store is closed again?
items.exampleTr: Dalga geçiyorsun herhalde. Mağaza yine mi kapalı?
items.simple: You cannot believe it is true, and you are a bit angry.
dialogue: A: The flight is cancelled again.
B: You've got to be kidding me.
A: I wish I were.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Malcolm in the Middle'da şaşkınlık/öfke.

items.example: I'm just saying, she never texts you back.
items.exampleTr: Sadece söylüyorum, sana hiç mesaj atmıyor.
items.simple: You say something a little hard, but you do not want a fight.
dialogue: A: Your new boyfriend is always late.
B: Why are you angry?
A: I'm just saying, be careful.
items.note: Friends'te arkadaşlar arası dürüst yorum.

items.example: He said, 'It's not you, it's me,' and left.
items.exampleTr: 'Sorun sen değilsin, benim,' dedi ve gitti.
items.simple: A kind thing people say when they end a love, even if it is not true.
dialogue: A: I ended it with Paul.
B: What did you say?
A: The classic: It's not you, it's me.
items.note: Ayrılık klişesi; Seinfeld ve Friends'te alay konusu.

items.example: Play it cool. Don't call him three times today.
items.exampleTr: Soğukkanlı ol. Bugün ona üç kere arama.
items.simple: Act calm so nobody sees you are excited or worried.
dialogue: A: She's walking over here!
B: Just play it cool.
A: I'm trying. My hands are shaking.
items.note: HIMYM'de flört taktiği anlatırken geçer.

items.example: He got cold feet a week before the wedding.
items.exampleTr: Düğünden bir hafta önce son anda korktu.
items.simple: You feel scared at the last moment about a big plan.
dialogue: A: Is Dan still marrying her?
B: He might get cold feet.
A: He has the ring in his pocket!
items.note: Friends'te düğün bölümlerinde sık geçer.

items.example: I don't want to be the third wheel tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu gece fazlalık olmak istemiyorum.
items.simple: Two people are a couple, and you are the extra person with them.
dialogue: A: Come to dinner with us!
B: No way, I'll be the third wheel.
A: Then bring a friend.
items.note: Roommate ve çift ortamı sahnelerinde duyulur.

items.example: I don't think she'd be into you, buddy.
items.exampleTr: Bence senden hoşlanmaz, dostum.
items.simple: You like a person or a thing very much.
dialogue: A: Would she be into a guy like me?
B: Why do you ask?
A: She laughed at all my jokes.
items.note: Günlük konuşmada ve Friends'te çok yaygın.

items.example: I ran into my ex at the supermarket.
items.exampleTr: Markette eski sevgilimle karşılaştım.
items.simple: You meet your old love by chance, and it is awkward.
dialogue: A: Guess who I saw today.
B: Did you run into your ex?
A: Yes, and I was wearing pajamas.
items.note: Dizilerde klasik bir komik an.

items.example: Can we talk? It's about last night.
items.exampleTr: Konuşabilir miyiz? Dün geceyle ilgili.
items.simple: You ask this when you have something serious to say.
dialogue: A: Can we talk?
B: Uh-oh. That sounds bad.
A: It's nothing terrible. Sit down.
items.note: Dizilerde genelde tatsız bir konuşmanın girişidir.

items.example: Let's grab a coffee after work.
items.exampleTr: İşten sonra bir kahve içelim.
items.simple: You go and get a coffee quickly, often with a friend.
dialogue: A: Do you have a minute?
B: Let's grab a coffee downstairs.
A: Perfect. I need the caffeine.
items.note: Central Perk sahnelerinin vazgeçilmezi.

items.example: Dinner is my treat tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu akşamki yemek benden.
items.simple: You pay for the other person.
dialogue: A: Let me pay for my part.
B: No, no. My treat.
A: Thanks! I'll get the next one.
items.note: Arkadaş ortamında hesabı üstlenirken.

items.example: I'm kind of seeing someone right now, so, no.
items.exampleTr: Şu an biriyle görüşüyorum, o yüzden hayır.
items.simple: You go on dates with one person, but it is not very serious yet.
dialogue: A: Want to go out Friday?
B: I'm kind of seeing someone.
A: Oh. Sorry, I didn't know.
items.note: Resmi olmayan ilişkiyi anlatır; Friends tarzı.

items.example: My aunt keeps trying to set me up with her neighbour.
items.exampleTr: Teyzem beni komşusuyla tanıştırmaya çalışıp duruyor.
items.simple: You help two people meet so they can go on a date.
dialogue: A: Mom wants to set up another date.
B: With whom this time?
A: Her dentist's son.
items.note: Modern Family ve HIMYM'de çöpçatanlık sahneleri.

items.example: He walked up to her and said, 'How you doing?'
items.exampleTr: Yanına gitti ve 'Nasılsın bakalım?' dedi.
items.simple: A friendly, flirty way to say hello to someone you like.
dialogue: A: Try a simple line.
B: How you doing?
A: Stop. That only works for Joey.
items.note: Friends'te Joey'nin ikonik flört repliği.

items.tr: iyi bir seri yakalamış, şansı yaver gitmiş
items.example: Wow, you're on a roll this week!
items.exampleTr: Vay, bu hafta şansın yaver gidiyor!
items.simple: Many good things happen to you, one after another.
dialogue: A: I won again!
B: You're on a roll tonight.
A: Don't jinx it.
items.note: Barney ve Jake Peralta'nın kendini över tarzında.

items.example: Keep it between us, but I kissed him.
items.exampleTr: Aramızda kalsın ama onu öptüm.
items.simple: A secret that only two people know.
dialogue: A: I have big news.
B: Tell me!
A: Keep it between us. I'm engaged.
items.note: Arkadaş dedikodusu sahnelerinde çok duyulur.

items.example: They broke up, but they got back together last week.
items.exampleTr: Ayrıldılar ama geçen hafta tekrar birlikte oldular.
items.simple: Two people who stopped loving each other start to be a couple again.
dialogue: A: Did Sam and Lily get back together?
B: Yes, and they are happy.
A: I give it a month.
items.note: Friends'te Ross ve Rachel'ın bitmeyen hikâyesi.

items.example: We're on a break, so don't ask me about him.
items.exampleTr: Mola veriyoruz, o yüzden bana onu sorma.
items.simple: You stop being a couple for a short time, but you are not sure about the end.
dialogue: A: Are you two still together?
B: We're on a break.
A: That never ends well.
items.note: Friends'te Ross ve Rachel tartışmasının kaynağı.

items.example: You two are perfect for each other.
items.exampleTr: Siz ikiniz birbiriniz için biçilmiş kaftansınız.
items.simple: You talk to two people together.
dialogue: A: Why are you two whispering?
B: Nothing. Just planning a surprise.
A: I don't believe you.
items.note: Friends ve HIMYM'de çiftlere seslenirken.

items.example: Sorry, I have a thing tonight, so I can't come.
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, bu akşam bir işim var, gelemem.
items.simple: You say you are busy, but you do not say why.
dialogue: A: Are you free on Saturday?
B: I have a thing.
A: What kind of thing?
items.note: Seinfeld ve HIMYM'de klasik kaçamak cevap.

items.example: Hang in there. It gets better.
items.exampleTr: Dayan. Düzelecek.
items.simple: You tell a person not to give up when things are hard.
dialogue: A: I don't think I can finish.
B: Hang in there. Almost done.
A: Thanks for being here.
items.note: Friends'te teselli sahnelerinde.
